convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorXTRIX_Histogram indicator and external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and money management. Custom smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) are not built-in MT5 indicators.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes position: BUY_Close triggered when histogram Value[1]>Value[2] (downtrend detected), SELL_Close triggered when Value[1]<Value[2] (uptrend detected)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing method: LOT=fixed lot at 0.1, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads 3 values from ColorXTRIX_Histogram buffer 0 at offsets SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2 (stored as Value[0], Value[1], Value[2]). Entry logic: When Value[1]<Value[2] (histogram declining/rising from negative zone), if Value[0]>Value[1] (momentum turning up) then BUY_Open. When Value[1]>Value[2] (histogram rising/falling from positive zone), if Value[0]<Value[1] (momentum turning down) then SELL_Open. If SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are input booleans that gate whether each side can open or close. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which handle position management internally. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests persistent state across restarts.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the ColorXTRIX_Histogram custom indicator logic from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA smoothing algorithms). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) must also be reimplemented - they encapsulate position checking, lot sizing via MarginMode, and order execution with deviation. The histogram crossover logic uses 3-bar comparison: current bar vs previous bar vs bar-before-previous for trend direction and momentum reversal detection. SignalBar input (default=1) means signals are evaluated on the last completed bar, making backtesting reliable with bar data. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points and may need digit-adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) depending on how TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles _Point conversion.
